title: Integration Test Acceptance Contract
description: Criteria for multi-component integration tests that verify system-level behavior

dimensions.name: Scenario clarity
dimensions.criterion: Test name and comments explain the end-to-end workflow being verified

levels.definition: Test name describes the workflow; setup comments explain component interactions
Test name is generic; no clear explanation of what scenario is being tested

dimensions.name: Dependency clarity
dimensions.criterion: External dependencies are explicit (DB, cache, API mocks, etc.)

levels.definition: All external dependencies documented in setup; mocks/fixtures clearly labeled
Unclear which dependencies are mocked vs. real; potential for environment-dependent failures

dimensions.name: Failure messages
dimensions.criterion: When assertions fail, the error message explains what went wrong

levels.definition: Descriptive assertion messages; logs or traces show component interaction
Generic assertion error; hard to diagnose component failure
